note: Frozen BEFORE any strategy ran under v2. Identical to protocol-v1 except the fixed-baseline rule. Changing any value is a new experiment.

supersedes.reason: v1's fixed rule (fixed_shortest/1) chose DIRECT(answer), which never receives the context columns, so it is not a meaningful comparator on a context-dependent dataset. The v2 rule is decided by the dataset shape only, not by any v1 result.

fixed_baseline_definition.inputs: TaskContract dataset shape only; never rows, targets, evaluations or scores; fails closed if not admissible

contract.instructions: Answer the multi-hop question using only the context paragraphs. Reply with the shortest exact answer (an entity name, date, number or short phrase), not a sentence.

search_implementations.aco: aco_mmas / aco_mmas/1 with default ACOConfig (unchanged from v1)

primary_metric: validation token F1 (mean token_f1 evaluator quality; INFEASIBLE runs score 0)
champion_selection: TaskContract.rank (feasible first, then pass rate at token F1 >= 0.5), then mean validation token F1, then earliest evaluation

execution.note: workers changes end-to-end time only; no authoritative pricing exists in the runtime, so cost is not reported
